title: 2026 Reunion - The Meeting: Spirit of Teamwork
description:
Each May in Richmond, Virginia, we invite shareholders, associates, community members, and friends worldwide to learn, engage, connect and have fun. We call this event the Reunion. 

Comprised of the Crawl, Walk & Run, the Forum panels, the Meeting, and the Reception, among other gatherings, the Reunion offers an unparalleled opportunity to better get to know the Markel Group and the community around it. 

This video is a replay of the 2026 Reunion Meeting. 

It includes the presentation of our Markel Style Award winners, an overview of our financial highlights, and a question-and-answer section with Markel Group leadership.

Learn more at www.mklreunion.com.
